title: GMAT vs. GRE Strategic Choice Engine
description: Profile-based scoring engine recommending GMAT vs. GRE for MBA and graduate applicants. Scores 7 profile dimensions (quant/verbal strength, target programs, timeline, prior experience, format preference, budget), produces target score tables by school tier, all-in cost comparison, and prep time estimate.
data_vintage: GMAT Focus Edition fees 2024 · GRE fees 2024 · GMAC/ETS score data 2023–24
regulatory_citations: GMAC GMAT Focus Edition launch 2023 (format change from Classic)
GMAC 2024 applicant survey and program score data
